note: Subject layer of the Undead visual-direction study (bead pulp_wars-3tq.11). Exploration only. The lines describe the violet base; the cyan and green options are derived from it.

subjects.UNIT:UNDEAD:FIGHTER: Subject: Skeleton, a chunky cute friendly skeleton warrior with a huge round pale warm ivory skull head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body made of bare bones: big dark round eye sockets with small glowing bright violet pupils and a wide toothy grin, a dented dark rusted iron half-helmet with a short ragged near-black crest, a bare pale ivory ribcage, spine and hip bones with no shirt, a short ragged near-black charcoal loincloth with a torn zigzag hem and a thin bright violet trim, thin pale ivory bone arms and legs, an oversized notched light grey iron sword held up in the right hand, a round dark iron shield with a tarnished bronze rim and a small ivory skull boss on the left arm, ivory bone hands and feet; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:UNDEAD:GUARD: Subject: Zombie, a chunky cute big shambling zombie with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a wide stocky body in a braced stance: pallid light ash grey skin with a few stitched seams, sleepy droopy eyes with small glowing bright violet pupils and a small lopsided grin, a tuft of dark charcoal hair, a ragged near-black charcoal smock with a torn zigzag hem and a thin bright violet trim covering the chest, belly and legs down to the shins, a necklace of small pale ivory bones, both arms stretched straight forward with big pale ivory bandaged hands, big dark grey feet; no weapon, no shield; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a slow heavy wall of a body, not a sword fighter.
subjects.UNIT:UNDEAD:CAPTAIN: Subject: Necromancer, a chunky cute old sorcerer with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a gaunt pallid light ash grey face with glowing bright violet eyes and a long ivory-white beard, a near-black charcoal pointed hood and a long near-black charcoal ragged robe with torn zigzag hems down to the feet and a thin bright violet trim along the hood and the hem, a small pale ivory skull clasp at the collar, a tall crooked dark iron staff held upright in the left hand, topped with a small pale ivory skull holding a bright violet flame high above his head, the right hand raised with small bright violet sparks, dark grey shoes; no shield, no helmet, no sword; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a spellcaster with a skull staff.
